name: dev.bonemerger
description: Destructive editor command that merges a bone into its parent, redistributing skin weights and recomputing bindposes so affected meshes deform identically. Right-click one or more bones in the Hierarchy and choose Bone Merger > Merge Selected Bone(s) Into Parent. Unlike the other tools in this repo this runs immediately and is not part of the NDMF build pipeline - use Undo (Ctrl+Z) to revert.
